sentences.text:
Deb Kumar Sardar vs Unknown on 4 March, 2025
Author: Debangsu Basak

Court No.26 S.D. Rejected Crm (Db) 4410 of 2024 In re: An Application for Bail under
Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 read with Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik
Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Deganga Police Station Fir No. 356 of 2021 dated
03.07.2021 under Sections 498A, 406, 307, 326, 304B, 302 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

-And- 
In the matter of: Deb Kumar Sardar ... ... Petitioner Mr. Dinesh Pani Ms. Sulagna Sen ... ...

For the
Petitioner Ms. Baishali Basu, Sr. Govt. Adv., Mr. R. Jana ... ...
For the State Petitioner renews the prayer for bail.
Trial is at the fag end.

Trial is fixed for the purpose of hearing the arguments of the respective advocates subsequent to the conclusion of the evidence and recording the statements under Section 313 of the Cr.P.C.
There exists a dying declaration of the victim implicating the petitioner.
At this stage, enlarging the petitioner on bail may not send correct signal to the society.
In such circumstances, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner and the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
